subject: Resale + Integration: proposed tiered commission exceptions and lead registry steps
messages:
From: Matt Jensen <matt.jensen@bridgepoint.io>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partnership ask — reseller + systems integration commercial carve-outs

Hi Priya,

Thanks for taking a quick look last week at a high level — following up with a short note and a proposed PDF with the exceptions we need for our integration-led resale model. BridgePoint is seeing strong demand for bundled implementation and 90-day POC credits for enterprise customers; to make the economics work we need two deviations from your standard partner playbook: a) a higher revshare tier (35%) on first-year ARR for deals where BridgePoint is delivering professional services and co-selling, and b) a 90-day attribution window for any leads we register that convert after a trial period.

We included a simple lead-registry Excel and a one-pager PDF (attached) showing the scenarios. The ask: can Redwood sign off on these exceptions for a pilot cohort of five enterprise customers? If yes, we want to start capturing leads in the registry and sync on a mutual action plan.

Attachments: revshare-exceptions-proposal-v1.pdf, lead-registry-template.xlsx

Would love to schedule 30 minutes early next week to talk through the operational details (who validates services, evidence needed for first-touch credit, and billing flow).

Best,
Matt
Head of Alliances, BridgePoint Systems

---
On Fri, 28 Aug 2026 at 15:03 Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks again for the intro at KubeSummit — great to meet.

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Matt Jensen <matt.jensen@bridgepoint.io>, Lily Qiao <lily.q@integral.io>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Partnership ask — reseller + systems integration commercial carve-outs

Ben / Marissa — looping you both in for deal ops and partner program input. BridgePoint is asking for a pilot exception (5 customers) that includes a higher first-year revshare when they both resell and deliver integration services, plus a 90-day attribution window that covers trial-to-paid conversions.

Key questions we need answered before we commit:
- Can Finance run a projection of MAU/ARR impact for a 35% first-year revshare vs our standard 20% for the pilot cohort? (Ben)
- What evidence will satisfy sales/legal for service-delivered credit? We want to avoid subjective sign-offs. Proposed idea: signed statement of work + invoice for implementation hours + customer attestation to Redwood. (Marissa)
- Operationally, should the lead registry be an explicit HubSpot property with a submission ID, or do we accept BridgePoint's XLS and ingest weekly?

Matt / Lily — quick ask for you: 1) can you outline the typical size and cadence of those bundled deals (avg first-year ARR, percent implementation revenue), and 2) confirm whether BridgePoint requires exclusivity by account during the 90-day window.

If we can get quick answers on those three items I can draft a short pilot addendum for legal to review. Planning to propose a canary cohort and a 60-day review to decide whether to standardize.

Thanks — Priya
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Priya Natarajan
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 11:14:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Partnership ask — reseller + systems integration commercial carve-outs

Quick modeling notes after a first pass:
- Baseline: 20% revshare on first-year ARR. At 35% for five pilot accounts (assume avg 1st-year ARR $220k), incremental cost to Redwood ~ $99k across cohort in year 1.
- Offsets: we expect lower acquisition/headcount cost and faster time-to-value from partner-led delivery; if partner covers implementation discounting that reduces Redwood's professional services revenue but increases net ARR growth.
- Risk controls to propose: 1) vesting schedule for elevated revshare — e.g., 20% for first 3 months from contract signing, 35% only after confirmed go-live and customer-signed SOW; 2) cap on total pilot eligibility per partner (this pilot = 5 customers max); 3) clawback clause if customer is self-sourced or found to have been in our pipeline before registration.

Attachments: I can produce a simple P&L scenario file if useful.

Ben
Director, GTM Finance

> "Evidence" for service delivery — recommend SOW + accepted deliverables checklist + customer email confirmation. Keeps sales/legal comfortable and is lightweight.
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Matt Jensen <matt.jensen@bridgepoint.io>, Lily Qiao <lily.q@integral.io>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2026 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Partnership ask — reseller + systems integration commercial carve-outs

Matt / Lily — thanks for the proposal and for answering our quick questions on the call this morning. Summary + next steps below so we have an agreed mutual action plan for the pilot cohort: 

Summary of agreement-in-principle:
- Pilot: up to 5 named enterprise accounts submitted via the partner lead registry (we will provide a HubSpot submission form and accept your weekly ingest for the pilot).
- Commissioning: elevated first-year revshare to 35% conditional on 1) partner-submitted signed SOW, 2) partner invoice for implementation hours, and 3) customer confirmation email acknowledging partner-delivered services. Prior to go-live the default revshare remains 20%; the uplift vests once evidence is received.
- Attribution window: 90 days from initial partner registration to count conversions from trial to paid; however, conversions that are demonstrably Redwood-sourced (existing opportunity in our CRM >30 days before registration) will be excluded.
- Limits & controls: pilot cap = 5 customers; single partner cannot exceed 2 pilots concurrently without Exec approval; 60-day pilot review to evaluate scaling. Clawback applies if evidence is falsified or customer was in active Redwood pipeline.

Action items (owners & dates):
- BridgePoint: submit 5 candidate accounts via registry by Sep 3, 2026 (Matt).
- Redwood Ops: provision HubSpot partner-registration form and weekly ingest workflow by Sep 6, 2026 (Marissa).
- Finance: finalize P&L scenarios and approve vesting/clawback language by Sep 8, 2026 (Ben).
- Legal: Priya will route a one-page pilot addendum template to BridgePoint for signature; target signature by Sep 10, 2026.

Matt — if that aligns I'll send the addendum draft today and Marissa will share the HubSpot link. Appreciate the partnership — excited to test this model.

Best,
Priya
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: revshare-exceptions-proposal-v1.pdf, lead-registry-template.xlsx
